source definitional: two structurally different restatements of the blocking policy, cross-checked before each case is written
seed 1
compare records
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 A clean chain, with nothing blocklisted or distrusted anywhere in it, is `trusted`
requirement R2 A cert whose SPKI hash is directly blocklisted blocks the chain: `blocked spki <role>`, naming that cert
requirement R3 A chain anchored at a distrusted root, with no SPKI hit anywhere in it, is `blocked root <root-id>`
requirement R4 When both could apply to the same chain, the SPKI block is reported, not the root distrust
requirement R5 A blocklist or distrust entry for other chains' certificates does not block this one, and an entry affects only chains after it
requirement E2E Several chains in one input, covering every verdict, judged independently
